messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: For how long must the employer keep the results of the checks on work equipment?

Facts:

[5] tracing log of data generated in relation to an intervention and of safety software versions — retentionPeriod — five years (P5Y) [condition: exclusively to demonstrate the conformity of the machinery or related product with this Annex further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]

[15] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[16] richiesta di prima verifica periodica — hasTimeLimit — 45 giorni (P45D) [inail-guide, p. 39]

[18] copy of EU declaration of incorporation, kept by importers — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 14(7)]
[19] prima verifica periodica — hasTimeLimit — entro 45 giorni (P45D) [inail-guide, p. 40]
[20] copy of certificate, technical file and relevant documents — retentionPeriod — a period of 15 years (P15Y) [DIR, Annex IX]
[21] copy of certificate, technical file and relevant documents — retentionPeriod — a period of 15 years (P15Y) [DIR, Annex IX]

[28] prima verifica periodica — hasTimeLimit — entro 45 giorni (P45D) [condition: dalla data di ricevimento della richiesta completa] [inail-guide, p. 36]
[29] economic operators: information referred to in paragraph 1 — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [REG, Art. 19(2)]
[30] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: in any event] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[31] datore di lavoro, richiesta di prima verifica periodica — hasObligation — allegare copia di tale attestazione alla richiesta di prima verifica periodica (allegare copia di tale attestazione alla richiesta di prima verifica periodica) [inail-guide, p. 29]
[32] datore di lavoro, controllo iniziale delle attrezzature di lavoro — hasObligation — dopo l'installazione e prima della messa in esercizio (dopo l'installazione e prima della messa in esercizio) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[33] datore di lavoro — hasObligation — richiesta di verifica periodica successiva (richiesta di verifica periodica successiva) [inail-guide, p. 35]

[35] prima verifica periodica — hasTimeLimit — entro 45 giorni dalla data di ricevimento della richiesta completa (P45D) [inail-guide, p. 29]
[36] datore di lavoro, controllo dopo ogni montaggio — hasObligation — dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto (dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]

[39] prima verifica periodica — hasTimeLimit — 45 giorni (P45D) [condition: dalla richiesta completa] [inail-guide, p. 31]
[40] safety function settings — requiresCheckAfter — After troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair work (after troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair work) [ur5e-manual, p. 204]
[41] load nut’s wear indicator — requiresPeriodicCheck — 6 months (P6M) [mastar-manual, p. 34]
[42] risultati dei controlli di cui al comma 8 — retentionPeriod — ultimi tre anni (P3Y) [condition: almeno quelli relativi agli ultimi tre anni] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 9]
[43] idroestrattori — hasObligation — il datore di lavoro dovrà attestare la conformità della macchina ai requisiti di sicurezza (il datore di lavoro dovrà attestare la conformità della macchina ai requisiti di sicurezza) [condition: Per gli idroestrattori privi di marcatura CE] [inail-guide, p. 27]

[46] verifica periodica richiesta all'Inail — hasTimeLimit — quarantacinque giorni (P45D) [condition: richiesta completa di tutti gli elementi previsti] [inail-guide, p. 13]
[47] digital EU declarations of incorporation — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[48] revisione periodica dei recipienti — hasTimeLimit — 31 dicembre del decimo anno successivo al collaudo (P10Y) [inail-guide, p. 23]

response.text: {"reasoning": "The question asks how long the employer must keep the results of the checks on work equipment. Fact 42 gives the retention period for the results of the checks under paragraph 8 of art. 71 of DLGS71 as the last three years (P3Y), with the condition that at least those relating to the last three years are kept. Fact 9 requires the records to be kept but gives no duration, so it does not change the answer. The other retention periods (10 years, 15 years, 1 year, 5 years) concern technical documentation, declarations of conformity or software logs, not the results of equipment checks.", "kind": "duration", "value": "P3Y", "text": "Under art. 71, paragraph 9 of DLGS71, the employer must keep the results of the checks under paragraph 8 for at least the last three years (P3Y).", "used": [42]}
